15	// gitHubHTTPSRe / gitHubSSHRe / gitHubBareRe parse the GitHub URL shapes
16	// `mirror create`/`remove` accept, mirroring the standalone entiredb CLI:
17	//
18	//	https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>(.git)
19	//	git@github.com:<owner>/<repo>(.git)
20	//	(github.com/)<owner>/<repo>
21	//
22	// owner/repo are lowercased so the synthesised /gh/<owner>/<repo> slug
23	// matches what the server persists.
24	//
25	// The owner/repo capture groups are restricted to GitHub's real identifier
26	// charset rather than a permissive "anything but slash". owner/repo flow
27	// unescaped into the STS audience (auth.RepoScopedToken) and the clone URL;
28	// a loose pattern would admit ?, #, %, .. and control chars, letting a name
29	// like `repo?bypass=1` smuggle a query string or `repo#x` truncate the path.
30	// GitHub owners are [A-Za-z0-9-] and repos are [A-Za-z0-9._-], so matching
31	// upstream reality closes those vectors at the boundary instead of relying on
32	// whatever the server does with weird strings.
33	const (
34		gitHubOwnerPat = `([A-Za-z0-9-]+)`
35		gitHubRepoPat  = `([A-Za-z0-9._-]+?)`
36	)
37	
38	var (
39		gitHubHTTPSRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^https?://github\.com/` + gitHubOwnerPat + `/` + gitHubRepoPat + `(?:\.git)?$`)
40		gitHubSSHRe   = regexp.MustCompile(`^git@github\.com:` + gitHubOwnerPat + `/` + gitHubRepoPat + `(?:\.git)?$`)
41		gitHubBareRe  = regexp.MustCompile(`^(?:github\.com/)?` + gitHubOwnerPat + `/` + gitHubRepoPat + `(?:\.git)?$`)
42	
43		// gitHubDotOnlyRe matches repo segments that are entirely dots
44		// (".", "..", ...). The tightened owner charset already excludes
45		// dots, but gitHubRepoPat allows ".", and a dot-only repo name would
46		// embed a literal ".." in both /gh/<owner>/<repo> and the
47		// token-exchange audience. Reject at the boundary.
48		gitHubDotOnlyRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^\.+$`)
49	)
50	
51	func parseGitHubURL(rawURL string) (owner, repo string, err error) {
52		for _, re := range []*regexp.Regexp{gitHubHTTPSRe, gitHubSSHRe, gitHubBareRe} {
53			m := re.FindStringSubmatch(rawURL)
54			if m == nil {
55				continue
56			}
57			owner, repo = strings.ToLower(m[1]), strings.ToLower(m[2])
58			if gitHubDotOnlyRe.MatchString(repo) {
59				return "", "", fmt.Errorf("invalid GitHub URL: repo cannot be dot-only: %s", rawURL)
60			}
61			return owner, repo, nil
62		}
63		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("not a recognized GitHub URL: %s", rawURL)
64	}
65	
66	// mirrorPollInterval is the cadence between mirror-status polls while waiting
67	// for the initial clone. A package var (not const) so tests can shorten it.
68	var mirrorPollInterval = 2 * time.Second
69	
70	// maxConsecutivePollErrors bounds how many back-to-back GetMirror failures the
71	// clone wait tolerates before giving up. A brief network/API glitch during a
72	// long initial clone shouldn't fail the create, but a persistent error
73	// (deleted mirror, revoked auth) should surface rather than spin to the
74	// deadline. The counter resets on any successful poll.
75	const maxConsecutivePollErrors = 5
76	
77	var (
78		// errMirrorCloneFailed reports the mirror's initial clone reached the
79		// terminal "failed" status — the server gave up cloning the upstream.
80		errMirrorCloneFailed = errors.New("initial clone failed")
81		// errMirrorSuspended reports the placement is suspended: registered, but the
82		// cluster won't serve it. Recovery is operator-side (explainSuspendedMirror).
83		errMirrorSuspended = errors.New("mirror is suspended")
84	)
85	
86	// mirrorStatusGetter is the slice of *coreapi.Client that awaitMirrorReady
87	// needs, declared as an interface so the poll is unit-testable with a fake.
88	type mirrorStatusGetter interface {
89		GetMirror(ctx context.Context, params coreapi.GetMirrorParams) (*coreapi.Mirror, error)
90	}
91	
92	// awaitMirrorReady polls the control plane for a mirror's clone lifecycle until
93	// it reaches a terminal status or the deadline/cancellation fires. It returns
94	// the last observed status plus:
95	//
96	//   - nil                     when ready (the repo is clonable)
97	//   - errMirrorCloneFailed    when the initial clone failed
98	//   - errMirrorSuspended      when the placement is suspended
99	//   - a timeout/transport err when the wait deadline passed, or polls kept
100	//     erroring past maxConsecutivePollErrors (transient glitches are retried)
101	//
102	// "processing" keeps the loop running. This replaces the old smart-HTTP
103	// info/refs probe: the control plane now reports clone readiness directly via
104	// Mirror.status, so a single authenticated control-plane call per tick suffices
105	// — no repo-scoped token exchange or data-plane round trip.
106	//
107	// onStatus (may be nil) is invoked with each observed status so callers can show
108	// live per-mirror progress (e.g. the wizard's Docker-style line list).
109	func awaitMirrorReady(ctx context.Context, c mirrorStatusGetter, mirrorID string, timeout time.Duration, onStatus func(coreapi.MirrorStatus)) (coreapi.MirrorStatus, error) {
110		if timeout > 0 {
111			var cancel context.CancelFunc
112			ctx, cancel = context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
113			defer cancel()
114		}
115		ticker := time.NewTicker(mirrorPollInterval)
116		defer ticker.Stop()
117	
118		var last coreapi.MirrorStatus
119		var consecutiveErrs int
120		for {
121			m, err := c.GetMirror(ctx, coreapi.GetMirrorParams{MirrorId: mirrorID})
122			switch {
123			case err != nil:
124				if ctx.Err() != nil {
125					return last, classifyWaitContextErr(ctx.Err())
126				}
127				// Tolerate transient glitches: the clone may still be progressing,
128				// so retry on the next tick. Only give up once errors persist.
129				consecutiveErrs++
130				if consecutiveErrs >= maxConsecutivePollErrors {
131					return last, fmt.Errorf("poll mirror status: %w", err)
132				}
133			default:
134				consecutiveErrs = 0
135				if s, ok := m.Status.Get(); ok {
136					last = s
137					if onStatus != nil {
138						onStatus(s)
139					}
140					switch s {
141					case coreapi.MirrorStatusReady:
142						return s, nil
143					case coreapi.MirrorStatusFailed:
144						return s, errMirrorCloneFailed
145					case coreapi.MirrorStatusSuspended:
146						return s, errMirrorSuspended
147					case coreapi.MirrorStatusProcessing:
148						// keep waiting
149					}
150				}
151			}
152			select {
153			case <-ctx.Done():
154				return last, classifyWaitContextErr(ctx.Err())
155			case <-ticker.C:
156			}
157		}
158	}
159	
160	// classifyWaitContextErr maps the clone wait's context error to a user-facing
161	// error: a user Ctrl+C exits quietly (SilentError, so main.go doesn't reprint
162	// it), while a real deadline reports the timeout.
163	func classifyWaitContextErr(err error) error {
164		if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
165			return NewSilentError(err)
166		}
167		return fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for initial clone: %w", err)
168	}
169	
170	// explainSuspendedMirror tells the user a suspended placement can't be served
171	// and to contact support. Suspension usually follows a loss of upstream GitHub
172	// access (App uninstalled, repo went private, or a transient API error); the
173	// fix is operator-side, so we point at support rather than leaking an internal
174	// admin command.
175	func explainSuspendedMirror(w io.Writer, mirrorID string) {
176		fmt.Fprintf(w,
177			"\nMirror %s is registered but suspended, so it can't be cloned yet.\n"+
178				"This usually means upstream GitHub access was lost (App uninstalled,\n"+
179				"the repo went private, or a transient API error). Contact support to\n"+
180				"restore it.\n",
181			mirrorID)
182	}

12	// TUI, so a CLI spinner here visually matches `entire activity`.
13	var spinnerFrames = []string{"⣾", "⣽", "⣻", "⢿", "⡿", "⣟", "⣯", "⣷"}
14	
15	const (
16		spinnerInterval = 100 * time.Millisecond
17		// spinnerInitialDelay is how long an operation must run before the
18		// spinner appears at all. Faster operations don't get a spinner —
19		// avoids flicker on warm runs that complete in under a quarter second.
20		spinnerInitialDelay = 250 * time.Millisecond
21	)
22	
23	// startSpinner prints msg followed by an animated spinner to w when the
24	// operation takes longer than spinnerInitialDelay. stop(true) leaves
25	// "✓ msg" on the line; stop(false) erases the line and writes nothing.
26	// On non-terminal writers the animation is omitted but stop(true) still
27	// prints the completion line.
28	func startSpinner(w io.Writer, msg string) func(success bool) {
29		if !interactive.IsTerminalWriter(w) {
30			return func(success bool) {
31				if success {
32					fmt.Fprintf(w, "✓ %s\n", msg)
33				}
34			}
35		}
36	
37		done := make(chan struct{})
38		stopped := make(chan struct{})
39		go func() {
40			defer close(stopped)
41			select {
42			case <-done:
43				return // operation finished before the spinner would appear
44			case <-time.After(spinnerInitialDelay):
45			}
46			ticker := time.NewTicker(spinnerInterval)
47			defer ticker.Stop()
48			frame := 0
49			fmt.Fprintf(w, "\r%s %s", spinnerFrames[frame], msg)
50			frame = (frame + 1) % len(spinnerFrames)
51			for {
52				select {
53				case <-done:
54					return
55				case <-ticker.C:
56					fmt.Fprintf(w, "\r%s %s", spinnerFrames[frame], msg)
57					frame = (frame + 1) % len(spinnerFrames)
58				}
59			}
60		}()
61		return func(success bool) {
62			close(done)
63			<-stopped
64			if success {
65				fmt.Fprintf(w, "\r\033[K✓ %s\n", msg)
66				return
67			}
68			fmt.Fprint(w, "\r\033[K")
69		}

Done. Two-phase progress now separates placement from cloning in the one-shot `entire repo mirror create <url> <cluster>` path.

**What changed** (`cmd/entire/cli/repo_mirror.go`):
- Added `onCreated` callback to `createAndAwaitMirror`, fired right after `CreateMirror` succeeds — the seam between the fast placement and the slow clone poll.

**New flow examples:**
- Fresh: `✓ Placing...` → `Cloning...` (spins) → `✓` → clone instructions
- Already ready: `✓ Placing...` → clone instructions (no cloning spinner)
- Create fails: placement line erased, error surfaces as before

- Wizard (`repo mirror create` no-args) passes `nil` for `onCreated` — unchanged; its multi-line progress already renders `creating`→`processing`→`ready` per mirror, so the placement/clone split is less useful there.
- `--no-wait` and empty upstreams skip the Cloning spinner entirely (nothing to await).
